pending_user_directives: Use independent professional judgment; routine architecture/research decisions should be made from mission and evidence rather than pushed back to the user.

The product must not optimize Agents for benchmark scores. Benchmarks exist to falsify the architecture; success means an industry researcher can quickly build a defensible industry mental model with structure, key variables, historical branches, contemporaneous cognition, outcomes, Evidence and unknowns.
Historical occurrence/target time should match source-supported precision; never manufacture exact dates for convenience. Known-time/no-lookahead eligibility remains a separate conservative boundary.

Model memory/search are discovery instruments, not publishable Evidence. A high-value unrecovered lead may remain an explicitly research-only indirectly corroborated hypothesis with alternatives and falsification conditions, but cannot silently become Fact/Judgment/Reality.

Verifiable formal listed-company announcements may use authoritative redistributors/programmatic acquisition when upstream identity and actual payload are preserved; derived platform fields require separate authority assessment and same-upstream redistributions are one evidence cluster.

Development storage boundary: externally acquired original PDF/HTML/filing/source packs belong in GitHub Release; Longcycle-generated DuckDB/replay/execution/runtime/database snapshots belong in Google Drive; live PostgreSQL is rebuilt when transactional semantics are needed and is never session-transported as authority.

Start formal ADC blind recall in a clean research vintage. The web freshness check used only to select ADC must not seed Memory Leads or Evidence; blind recall must be sealed before ADC historical self-verification/search.
Every substantive work session must update the repository handoff before returning control, so the next Agent never depends on chat memory.
